summary: Fees $33 + $6 electric + $19 full hookup confirmed (the $33 is one RV site, 160, pad 35.5 ft); added off-peak $29/$35. Added 50-amp/W/S, 193 sites to 100 ft (5 pull-through), showers/flush/laundry/dump/water/store, year-round with winter loop note, deep link, 14-night max. AWH's note kept.
flags: Phone missing: (330) 296-3239 'Campground Office ... hours vary. Open mid-April to November 1' (also the camp store). Park office (330) 235-0030, open 8am-4pm Monday, Thursday and Friday.
Pin fine: 4 m from the RV sites' centre (41.14280,-81.11295).

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored 'not waterfront', firsthand --AWH: 'campground is in a standard wooded loop layout not directly on the shoreline'). ODNR's page says 'Some lakeside sites offer carry-in boat access', and ODNR's site map (Rev 8/20) with the roads on NAIP puts sites 1-22 along the south shore road, 40-60 along the east shore and 103-109 at the northeast tip. Those rows want a pad-to-water reading; the rest are inland as AWH says. Not changed, AWH text kept.

ReserveOhio's per-site coordinates are not usable here: on imagery they are stretched outward from the park's centre, with sites 1-17, 153-165 and 109 plotted in the lake. The centre is still right (4 m from the pin); distances to the shore have to come from ODNR's map.

Rates: the full-hookup off-peak price is $35 (site 087), the same as electric, because off-peak prices don't step up for hookups; but ODNR says only electric sites 1-33 stay open, and the grid agrees (32 units free in facility 569, facility 570 blocked), so a full-hookup site can't really be had at $35 in winter.
No SPLIT: the bridle camp is a separate area per ODNR, but equestrian-only and primitive, so it is not a second RV campground.
